Try changing the banner text in Cookies → Settings → Cookie Consent and then refresh this page to see the changes.", 'post_status' => 'publish', 'post_type' => 'page' ]); if ($demo_page_id && !is_wp_error($demo_page_id)) { update_option('show_on_front', 'page'); update_option('page_on_front', $demo_page_id); } // Create / assign a Privacy Policy page, which Cookie Notice can link to $privacy_page = get_page_by_path('privacy-policy'); if (!$privacy_page) { $privacy_page_id = wp_insert_post([ 'post_title' => 'Privacy Policy', 'post_name' => 'privacy-policy', 'post_content' => "This is a demo privacy policy page for the Cookie Notice Playground setup.\n\nBelow is an example of the [cookies_revoke] shortcode so you can demonstrate revoking consent:\n\n[cookies_revoke]", 'post_status' => 'publish', 'post_type' => 'page' ]); } else { $privacy_page_id = $privacy_page->ID; } if (!empty($privacy_page_id) && !is_wp_error($privacy_page_id)) { update_option('wp_page_for_privacy_policy', $privacy_page_id); } // Configure Cookie Notice banner text + buttons in a version‑agnostic way $options = get_option('cookie_notice_options', []); if (function_exists('Cookie_Notice')) { $cn = Cookie_Notice(); if (is_array($cn->options)) { $options = $cn->options; // Use the plugin's normalized options array if available } } if (!is_array($options)) { $options = []; } // Many modern versions nest options under a `general` key; older ones are flat. $targets = []; if (isset($options['general']) && is_array($options['general'])) { $targets[] = &$options['general']; } else { $targets[] = &$options; } foreach ($targets as &$target) { if (!is_array($target)) { continue; } foreach ($target as $key => $value) { if (is_string($value)) { $lower = strtolower($value); // Heuristically replace the main banner copy (usually the long string mentioning cookies) if (strpos($lower, 'cookie') !== false && strlen($value) > 30) { $target[$key] = 'This is a Cookie Notice Playground demo. These texts come from Cookies → Settings and were preconfigured by the blueprint.'; } } // Button labels across various historical keys if (in_array($key, ['accept', 'accept_text', 'accept_text_cookie'], true)) { $target[$key] = 'Accept demo cookies'; } if (in_array($key, ['refuse', 'refuse_text', 'refuse_text_cookie'], true)) { $target[$key] = 'Reject non‑essential cookies'; } if (in_array($key, ['revoke', 'revoke_text'], true)) { $target[$key] = 'Change your cookie settings'; } } // Make sure the refuse / revoke flows are actually enabled when this flag exists. if (isset($target['refuse_opt'])) { // Plugin casts this to int, so 1 works across versions $target['refuse_opt'] = 1; } } update_option('cookie_notice_options', $options); if (function_exists('Cookie_Notice')) { // Keep the in‑memory copy in sync so the current request uses our values too Cookie_Notice()->options = $options; }
